name: snaplab API
description: snaplab renders web pages with a real headless Chromium and hands you the bytes. - `POST|GET /api/render` — URL **or** raw HTML → PNG / JPEG / WebP / AVIF / PDF, viewport or full page, retina, dark mode, element clipping. - `POST|GET /api/render/image` — HTML (or a `{{ template }}` + `data`) → a fixed-size image. The Open Graph card path. - `POST /api/render/preview` — unauthenticated, rate-limited demo render. - `POST /api/tools/*` — key-less public tools, 20 renders/day/IP, always answered with a hosted URL. - `/mcp` — a stateless Streamable-HTTP MCP server exposing `screenshot`, `pdf`, `html_to_image` and `usage`. ## Authentication Every endpoint except `/api/health`, `/api/render/preview` and `/api/tools/*` needs an API key. Keys look like `sk_…` and are created in the dashboard or through `POST /api/keys`. 1. `Authorization: Bearer sk_…` — the header form, accepted everywhere. 2. Signed query parameters — `GET /api/render` and `GET /api/render/image` only. See below. 3. The browser session cookie, for the dashboard itself. ### Signed URLs Putting a raw key in an `` leaks it. Sign the URL instead: append `keyId` (the API key's id) and `sig=hex(HMAC_SHA256(signing_secret, canonical))`, optionally with an `expires` Unix timestamp. The canonical string is every query pair except `sig`, sorted by name then value and joined with `&`. The per-key signing secret and a URL builder live in the dashboard under Keys. ## Options Options are camelCase and identical between the JSON body and the query string. In a query string, booleans are `true`/`1` and `false`/`0`, `hideSelectors` is a comma-separated list, and PDF options take either the dotted form (`pdf.format=A4`) or the flat alias (`pdfFormat=A4`). ## Caching and quota Identical options are served from a shared cache for 24h. **Cache hits and failed renders do not count against your quota** — only fresh, successful renders do. Renders carry `X-Snaplab-Cache`, `X-Snaplab-Duration-Ms`, `X-Snaplab-Fingerprint` and `X-Snaplab-Quota-Remaining`. Pass `cache: false` to force a fresh render. ## Errors Errors are JSON: `{"error":"…","code":"…"}`. Messages are for humans; codes are stable. | Status | Code | Meaning | | --- | --- | --- | | 400 | — | A parameter is missing, malformed, out of range, or the target is a private/blocked address. | | 401 | `unauthorized` | Missing, unknown or revoked API key; or a bad signature. | | 402 | `payment_required` | The subscription is past due. | | 422 | `selector_not_found` | The page rendered but `selector` matched nothing. | | 429 | `quota_exceeded` | The monthly render allowance is used up. | | 429 | — | Too many requests per minute for your plan. | | 502 | `upstream` | The target site was unreachable. | | 503 | `capacity` / `not_ready` | The render queue is saturated, or the browsers are still starting. Retry shortly. | | 504 | `timeout` | The page did not finish in time. | ## Plans | Plan | Renders / month | Price | Rate | Concurrency | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | free | 100 | $0 | 30/min | 1 | | starter | 2,000 | $9 | 120/min | 3 | | pro | 10,000 | $29 | 300/min | 5 | | business | 40,000 | $79 | 600/min | 10 |
